title: Search with wildcards

problem.name: Search with wildcards
problem.statement_latex: An unknown string $x\in\{0,1\}^n$ is accessed through queries $(S,y)$, where $S\subseteq[n]$ and $y\in\{0,1\}^{S}$, returning whether $x|_S=y$. Recover $x$ exactly with bounded error.
